item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence that Tshisekedi took actions specifically aimed at reducing nuclear risk, arms-control risk, or other explicit existential-risk categories. What I did find is regional conflict-management evidence: ceasefire support, peace-process engagement, and diplomatic talks around eastern DRC. So for this lens, the evidence is indirect and mixed, with a modest lean toward de-escalation in the eastern Congo conflict, but not strong proof of deliberate existential-risk reduction in the narrow sense.","evidence":[{"title":"Crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la Rdc : Les Présidents Félix Tshisekedi Et Joao Lourenco appellent au respect du cessez-le-feu","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-08-12","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_joao_lourenco_appellent_au_respect_du_cessez_le_feu","summary":"Tshisekedi met with Angola’s president, backed the Luanda process, welcomed the 4 August ceasefire, and said his government was fully available for the next negotiation steps. This is direct evidence of seeking de-escalation rather than escalation.","question_ids":["1B.1"]},{"title":"Crise sécuritaire dans l’Est de la Rdc : Les Présidents Félix Tshisekedi et Salva Kiir appellent au respect des accords de paix","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-03-25","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_salva_kiir_appellent_au_respect_des_accords_de_paix","summary":"After talks with South Sudan’s president, Tshisekedi called for an urgent relaunch of the Nairobi and Luanda peace processes and said he would spare no effort to restore peace, security, and stability in eastern Congo and the region.","question_ids":["1B.1"]},{"title":"Readout of the Secretary-General’s meeting with H.E. Mr. Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo, President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo","publisher":"UN Secretary-General","date":"2024-09-24","url":"https://www.un.org/sg/en/content/sg/readouts/2024-09-24/readout-of-the-secretary-generals-meeting-he-mr-felix-antoine-tshisekedi-tshilombo-president-of-the-democratic-republic-of-the-congo-scroll-down-for-french","summary":"The UN said Tshisekedi and the Secretary-General discussed eastern DRC and ongoing regional peace efforts, and the UN reiterated support for regional peace initiatives. This supports the view that his diplomacy in 2024 was oriented toward conflict reduction.","question_ids":["1B.1"]},{"title":"Secretary Blinken's Call with DRC President Tshisekedi","publisher":"U.S. Department of State, reposted by GlobalSecurity","date":"2024-12-27","url":"https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/library/news/2024/12/mil-241227-state01.htm","summary":"The readout says Blinken thanked Tshisekedi for his commitment to the Luanda process and for willingness to engage in talks on 2024-12-15. It also shows external actors viewed him as at least participating in de-escalatory diplomacy.","question_ids":["1B.1"]},{"title":"Face à la presse, le Président Félix Tshisekedi a peint un tableau d’espoir de la RDC","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-02-23","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/face_a_la_presse_le_president_felix_tshisekedi_a_peint_un_tableau_despoir_de_la_rdc","summary":"Tshisekedi emphasized a major military buildup and explicitly framed the eastern security problem partly through armed force. Even though he also said he wanted lasting peace, the military-first framing is evidence that weakens a pure “risk reduction” reading.","question_ids":["1B.1"]},{"title":"Brookings Institution : « nous sommes déterminés à ramener la paix en Rdc à n'importe quel prix ! » a déclaré le Président Félix Tshisekedi","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-07-24","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/brookings_institution_nous_sommes_determines_a_ramener_la_paix_en_rdc_a_nimporte_quel_prix_a_declare_le_president_felix_tshisekedi","summary":"Tshisekedi publicly presented himself as determined to restore peace and linked that goal to economic development. This is favorable on intent, but it is still a general peace statement rather than evidence on nuclear or existential-risk policy.","question_ids":["1B.1"]}]}
